title: Limit Order Matching Engine
task: Process limit BUY and SELL orders using price-time priority. A BUY order matches the lowest available SELL price that does not exceed its limit. A SELL order matches the highest available BUY price that meets its limit. Orders at the same price are matched FIFO. The trade price is the price of the resting order. Print every trade, then print the remaining BUY book ordered by descending price and FIFO, followed by the remaining SELL book ordered by ascending price and FIFO.

title: Weighted Grid Shortest Path
task: Find the minimum travel cost from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell of a weighted grid. Movement is allowed up, down, left, and right. A value of -1 represents an obstacle. The starting cell cost is excluded, while the cost of every entered cell is included. Also count how many distinct minimum-cost paths exist.

SNAPSHOT prints all active key-value pairs sorted by key, or EMPTY when no active keys remain. Input timestamps are non-decreasing.
